CRITICAL N+1 query pattern
IMPACT: HIGH

N+1 DATABASE QUERY

app/database.py · Line 42

The application performs an additional database query for every user in the result set. As user count grows, database load scales linearly — increasing response time and reducing overall capacity.

before — app/database.py:42
# Retrieve all users
users = get_users()

# ⚠ N+1: one extra query per user
for user in users:
    user.orders = get_orders(user.id)
QUERY SCALING
1 user → 1 query
100 users → 100 queries
1,000 users → 1,000 queries
WHY THIS MATTERS
More users ↓ More database queries ↓ Higher database load ↓ Higher response time ↓ Lower application capacity
◇ BOB ANALYSIS
